summary: Collective Mining Ltd., a Toronto-based gold-silver explorer listed on NASDAQ and TSX, filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting assay results from thirteen diamond drill holes at its Guayabales Project's Apollo Deposit in Colombia. Six holes tested the Shallow Halo Zone, intersecting shallow, broad oxidized precious-metal mineralization above the 0.3 g/t AuEq cutoff, including 135.15m @ 2.12 g/t AuEq from 21.30m. Approximately 80 percent of the Shallow Halo Zone remains untested; three rigs are active. No deal terms, stake, price, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. This is a routine exploration update, not a special situation; the risk angle is resource-growth execution, not arbitrage.
